headline: Cathay Financial Holding's First Three Quarters Profit Reaches NT$38.9 Billion; Including FVOCI Gains Reaches NT$93.6 Billion, Setting New Same-Period High - Liberty Finance
summary: Cathay Financial Holding reported September single-month after-tax profit of NT$2.641 billion. Cumulative first-three-quarter profit reached NT$38.931 billion, with EPS of NT$2.26. Including FVOCI gains, profit totaled NT$93.6 billion.
why: Cathay Financial is one of Taiwan's largest financial holding companies, with insurance and banking operations whose earnings reflect the island's financial market.
